"Ever wondered if she's into you? What if I told you the secret lies in her body language? This changes everything about the way you perceive attraction!"

"I know, it's confusing, right? You're there, hanging out, but you can't tell if she's just being friendly or if she's actually into you."

"Trust me, I’ve been there too, and after studying body language for years, I've uncovered the truth."

[SOLUTION REVEAL] (30-40 seconds)
"Here are 3 things to look out for: 1) She leans into you while talking, 2) She mimics your movements, 3) She maintains eye contact longer than usual."

[PROOF/RESULTS/TRANSFORMATION] (40-50 seconds)
"Thousands of people have used these signs to decode attraction and guess what? It works like a charm!"

[CALL-TO-ACTION + ENGAGEMENT QUESTION] (50-60 seconds)
"So, start paying attention to these signs and share your stories below! Do you agree with these signs or do you have more to add? Let's get the conversation started!"

[VISUAL: Host pointing downwards]
[TONE: Excited]
[PACE: Fast]

"And before you go, don't forget to hit that subscribe button for more secrets revealed about body language and attraction. Stay tuned, because this is just the tip of the iceberg!"
